item.title: Kinmen: The Sleepy Fishing Island That Could Be East Asia’s Biggest Flashpoint
item.description: The island, administered by Taipei but just 2 miles from the mainland, has a culture and lifestyle all its own.

item.title: The Hidden Famine: What I Saw in North Korea’s Darkest Years
item.description: “With the collapse of the Public Distribution System, which had been the sole source of food, many urban residents, unable to grow anything for themselves, simply wasted away in their homes, starving quietly and out of sight.”
